name: qBittorrent
description: qBittorrent is an open-source BitTorrent client you can control from a web interface. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys qBittorrent as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Open source BitTorrent client. Deploy qBittorrent with Docker Compose on Dokploy – check the container logs for your temporary admin password on first login.
configText: The exact qBittorrent Docker Compose and template configuration this template deploys.
